description: This file defines the GreaterThan class, which implements a comparison operator for 'greater than' logic in the OpenMRS logic framework. It provides a textual representation of the operator used in query expressions.

classes.name: GreaterThan
classes.description: A class representing the 'greater than' comparison operator within the OpenMRS logic framework.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string 'GREATER THAN' as the textual representation of this operator.
